name: Mombasa-Nairobi Standard Gauge Railway
backer: China Exim Bank (about 90%); China Road and Bridge Corp built and operated it
china_gets: Building and operating contracts for a Chinese state firm; Libor+3.6% on the commercial loan; a 15-year take-or-pay cargo guarantee
host_case: Kenya's biggest project since independence; Ruto published the loan documents in 2022

name: Addis Ababa-Djibouti Railway
value: About $4bn; Ethiopia's $2.49bn China Exim loan was restructured in 2018 and now matures in 2044
backer: China Exim Bank; CREC and CCECC built it
china_gets: Building contracts for CREC, CCECC and NORINCO; Libor+3% interest; a supply corridor to Djibouti's ports, where China Merchants owns a stake
host_case: Ethiopia's main route to the sea

name: Port de Djibouti / Doraleh stake
value: China Merchants bought 23.5% of Port de Djibouti S.A. for $185m in 2012-13
china_gets: A share in Djibouti's port operator, on the Bab el-Mandeb strait
host_case: Djibouti presents itself as a neutral hub that hosts many countries' bases

name: PLA support base, Djibouti
value: Opened 1 Aug 2017; lease reported at about $20m a year
china_gets: China's first overseas base; about 400 PLA marines and a pier for large warships (US DoD, cited by CRS)
host_case: Beijing calls it a support facility for anti-piracy and evacuation missions

name: Lamu Port (LAPSSET)
backer: Built by China Communications Construction Co; funded by Kenya
china_gets: A building contract for CCCC; no Chinese ownership stake found
host_case: Kenya's gateway to South Sudan and Ethiopia

name: Bagamoyo Port
value: $10bn plan agreed in 2013 with China Merchants and Oman; suspended in 2019; the Chinese partner pulled out in 2022
backer: Formerly China Merchants; now an MoU with AGL (MSC), signed Dec 2025
host_case: Tanzania's ports authority rejected the terms: tax exemptions and the investors' freedom to set port charges

name: Sicomines copper-cobalt (minerals for infrastructure)
value: Up to $7bn of infrastructure under the revised 2024 deal
china_gets: Copper and cobalt output in exchange for infrastructure
host_case: Kinshasa renegotiated the deal for more infrastructure

name: Chinese loans to Africa, 2000-2024
value: $180.87bn in 1,319 loan commitments from 42 lenders (amounts committed, not paid out)
backer: China Exim Bank, China Development Bank and others
china_gets: Interest; contracts for Chinese firms; repayment in resources in some deals
host_case: Governments say they borrowed to fill gaps Western lenders left

name: Top Chinese borrowers in Africa, 2000-2023
value: Angola $46.05bn cumulative; ranking after it: Ethiopia, Egypt, Nigeria, Kenya, Zambia, South Africa, Sudan, Ghana, Cameroon (dollar figures for those not in the brief)
backer: China Exim Bank, China Development Bank
china_gets: Oil-backed repayment in Angola's case; contracts for Chinese firms
host_case: Angola negotiated debt relief in 2024 rather than restructuring

name: Lekki Deep Sea Port
backer: China Harbour Engineering (CHEC) built it; China Development Bank financed
host_case: Lagos calls it Nigeria's first deep-sea port

name: Dar es Salaam port upgrade
value: World Bank-financed berths 1-7, RoRo, channel works
backer: China Harbour Engineering (contractor); World Bank financing
china_gets: Construction contracts only; operators are DP World (berths 4-7) and Adani (CT2)
host_case: Dar es Salaam chose Gulf and Indian operators

name: Kribi deep-water port
value: Container terminal run by KCT consortium
backer: China Harbour Engineering built it; CHEC is a KCT shareholder with CMA CGM and Bollore
china_gets: Shareholding in the terminal operator (exact % not confirmed in a filing)

name: Husab and Rossing uranium
backer: CGN and China-Africa Development Fund (Taurus Minerals, 90% of Swakop Uranium); CNNC's CNUC at Rossing
china_gets: Uranium supply; Namibia's state Epangelo holds 10% of Husab
host_case: Namibia keeps a state stake and royalty

name: Arcadia and Bikita lithium
value: Huayou paid $422m for 100% of Arcadia (completed Apr 2022); Sinomine paid $180m for 74% of Bikita
china_gets: Lithium concentrate for Chinese battery supply chains
host_case: Zimbabwe banned raw lithium ore exports in Dec 2022 to force local processing
